title: Big with a thick seam on stem
text: Big with a thick seam on stem. These aren’t delicate in my opinion and are a bit too clunky for me to use. When you hold the glass by the stem, you can feel a thick seam. However, they are balanced and don’t wobble when on a flat surface. And the glass itself looks like it doesn’t have impurities or bubbles in it.
